==Background==
{{Quote|Thank you for watching and listening! I'm crying whilst reading the comments, I'm happy that I can deliver my feelings…|Author's Comment}}
"'''I'm Mine'''" is an original song produced by halyosy. It was commissioned for the video game ''{{IW|projectsekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}''.

This song has entered the ''[[Hall of Fame]]'' and exceeded 2 million views on YouTube.
